## findings
1. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — mislabelled effect, share settlement left without a method factor (class F-LABEL, `_difficulty.md` findings). Symptom: `settleable_portion` is labelled `method` but its three tiers are "the whole share owed" / "the share owed less half of mounting_balancing_charge_per_tire" / "the share owed less the mounting charge" — one formula, share − k × 21.00 with k ∈ {0, ½, 1}. Evidence: compute `settleable` in tires_ext_share_settlement; factor block `effect: method`. Consequence: honestly labelled, tires_ext_share_settlement has 5 parameter and 0 method factors (bound: >= 1 method). Same class in this task: `price_paid_basis` of tires_ext_treadwear_credit (152 − X/4, X ∈ {40, plan discount, 0}) — mislabelled, though the credit keeps aged_set_proration as a genuine method; `redemption_base_rule` (borderline, PLAUSIBLE). Affected: tires.extended.yaml S and C factors; computations of steps 16 and 18.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal baseline value (class F-REAL-1). Symptom: the root's baseline "The redemption percentage is standard_redemption_pct" (20) and the share settlement's "The settlement percentage is standard_settlement_pct" (50) meter how much of an already-issued treadwear credit the customer may use. Demonstrated on this world: after the gold flow 7.77 of the customer's credit stays unapplied although the replacement tire costs 159.99 and she asked for "your treadwear warranty credit for that worn tire put toward the new tire ticket"; the base rule allows up to tires_msr_credit_remaining. The ladders' conditions "card purchase in the last 1 month" (S), "road hazard certificate status" (S), "a card purchase on or after the latest inspection" (T) are not things a tire retailer weighs for how much of an issued credit may be applied. Affected: S and T rules/baselines; scored amounts 37.57 and 14.30.
3. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — unreal ladder / dishonest baseline, `weekly_storage_rate` of tires_ext_lapsed_order_refund (class F-LADDER-WEEKLY). Its fall-through (2.00/week) is never charged in any world; the time part of tiers 1–2 holds of every order whose weekly rate is used; its declared baseline is not stated by baseline.rule (no storage charge). The 425.44 sensitivity figure is a number no baseline reader produces. The live ladder has 2 tiers; P3 keeps 4 honest factors after striking it.
4. SOURCE-FACTOR RED (PLAUSIBLE) — F-BUNDLE: `price_paid_basis` tier 2 deducts the alignment plan's bundle discount (given on the plan price per the alignment charter) from the tire price. Not taken on this world (instant-savings tier precedes it); no scored value moves.
5. SOURCE-POLICY RED (charter, no value moved here) — F-UNDECL-MILES: C reads miles from the latest inspection, base from the inspection the adjustment rests on; undeclared. Here both are 1a95cff9's 39460.
6. Observation O-T0-1: the share-settlement edge's condition ("… with the odometer of the latest tires_treadwear_adjustment entry …") is vacuous on the raw opening DB (no adjustment exists) and becomes false only after the credit write; the share itself is genuinely unsettled at the opening (no credit-applied row naming LF).
7. Observation O-T0-2: persona line "told you that your part of that one would be settled when the new rear tire goes on" (only on the agent's question) tells the agent that the LF share is to be settled in this transaction — a mild pointer to the share-settlement prerequisite, not volunteered.
8. Observation O-ORDERED-TICKET (`_difficulty.md`): card purchase b9844db9 (206.11) shows the still-ordered ticket T-15093342 rang installation charges at purchase, contradicting L's overwrite premise; no second scored answer.
Relation to previous revisions: none (first revision).
